SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_cost_ratio, color_rank
FROM (
  SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_cost_ratio,
         RANK() OVER (
           PARTITION BY product_color
           ORDER BY (avg_quantity IS NULL), avg_quantity DESC
         ) AS color_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT ili.order_item_id, p.product_color,
           AVG(ili.product_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
           AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_cost_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
    JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
    GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color
  )
)
WHERE color_rank <= 3
